environment.description: EKS pod running with IAM role arn:aws:iam::112233445566:role/webhook-relay-prod attached via IRSA. The role has policy allowing s3:*, ec2:Describe*, and sts:AssumeRole on cross-account roles. Pod runs in default namespace with no network policies. IMDS v1 enabled on nodes (HttpTokens: optional). No egress filtering. Service exposed via internal NLB.
